messages.色欲共鳴で「硬血甲冑」を減らさずに5まで保ち、強化S3「ウヴェルテューレ」を撃つ: Maintain 5 Hardblood Armor through Lust Resonance without losing it, then unleash enhanced S3 Ouvertüre. He also supports La Manchaland allies by sharing Armor and granting them Focused Performance.
messages.硬血甲冑を5に保つ: 硬血甲冑(最大5)は、攻撃終了時に体力ダメージを受けると1: **Keeping Hardblood Armor at 5**: Hardblood Armor (maximum 5) decreases by 1 when he takes HP damage at the end of an attack. With Lust Resonance, it does not decrease (but healing is halved instead). The counter Coagulation grants 1 Hardblood Armor on Clash Win, twice per turn. If his Hardblood Armor is 5, S3 activates as Ouvertüre.
messages.「ウヴェルテューレ」: 攻撃加重値3。自分以外の味方(最大共鳴数の人数)へ硬血甲: **Ouvertüre**: 3 Attack Weight. Gives 2 Hardblood Armor (+1 with Lust Resonance) to allies other than himself, as many as the highest Resonance, and applies La Mancha Parade. After the attack, he spends all of his Hardblood Armor.
messages.演技集中: 常時パッシブ「王子であった者がすべきこと」により、ターン開始時、硬血: **Focused Performance**: Through the always-active passive Responsibility of a Former Prince, at Turn Start, La Manchaland Identities with maximum Hardblood Armor gain 1 Focused Performance. When such an Identity is staggered by damage, it spends all Hardblood Armor to recover from Stagger, once per stage per Identity.
messages.硬血甲冑の配布: S1「行進指揮」・S2「再建の義務」は、血餐を最大10消耗して: **Distributing Hardblood Armor**: S1 March Conductor and S2 Responsibility to Rebuild spend up to 10 Bloodfeast to give Hardblood Armor to himself and 1 ally (+1 for La Manchaland members). Bloodfeast accumulates from the Bleed damage taken by all characters.
messages.バトルパッシブ「「血をまとい、仮面を被り、血を命ずるがままに」」(色欲×3・傲慢: **Combat passive — 'Bloodied, Masked, and as Blood Commands' (3 Lust and 3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, he gains Offense and Defense Level Up with 3 or more Hardblood Armor, and Haste for the next turn with 4 or more. With Focused Performance, landing attacks applies La Mancha Parade.
messages.色欲の共鳴を作って自分の硬血甲冑を減らさないようにし、S1・S2・反撃で5まで育: Build Lust Resonance so his Hardblood Armor does not decrease, grow it to 5 with S1, S2, and his counter, then fire Ouvertüre. Hand out Armor to La Manchaland allies so they gain Focused Performance. Paired with Rodion's The Princess of La Manchaland, both of their S3s deal +15% damage.
